title: MyZoraBot
tagline: This Zora Discord bot can help make a blockchain platform more user-friendly and successful by providing information, updates, and engaging features.
description: MyZoraBot can be a useful tool on a blockchain platform by providing information and updates to users in real-time on balance, transactions and other info. Additionally, a bot can help to keep a community organized and engaged by providing a variety of features and tools provided by Zora API. For example, with this Discord Bot it can help to interact new mints in the channel, keep track of events and announcements, or even provide games and quizzes. By providing value and utility, this Zora Discord bot can help to make a blockchain platform more user-friendly and successful.
how_its_made: This project uses TypeScript, Discord.js and Zora API. This chat bot that helps you with information  of your NFT collections and the minted information of other users in mainnet.  Furthermore, it allows users to interact with the blockchain in a more natural way. By using MyZoraBot,  users can ask questions about the blockchain and receive answers in a conversational format. This makes it easier for users to understand the blockchain and use it to its full potential.
